The '''Defense Network Control Center''' was located in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. It contained the primary control node for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] factories located on the moon.
